source_segments.text: Harry Parkes (footballer, born 1888) Harold Arnold "Harry" Parkes (September 1888 – March 1947) was an English footballer and the manager of various football clubs in the 1920s and 1930s.
Parkes attended Halesowen Grammar School and played for local sides Halesowen Amateurs, Coombs Wood and Halesowen before joining West Bromwich Albion in February 1906.
His debut came against Notts County in March 1907 in the FA Cup and he played in the semi-final defeat against Everton later that season.
He left after falling out with the West Bromwich Albion management and joined Coventry City in May 1908.
